summary: The root help and the description metadata must not say fleet planning resumes after a quota stop. Only address clean resumes (--resume); fleet plan never caches plans and rebuilds every chunk, so reruns need the orders not yet planned, selected by removing the order_id values already in the stops output.
reason: The published help promised resumption for every batch command, which made users spend the small route-plan pool again on orders already planned. A regen restores the generic template help text, so the Highlights block has to be re-applied with this wording.
